title: Score prédictif de mortalité préopératoire (PMP)
formula:
Addition of the selected points:

| Variable | Points | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Inpatient | No | 0 |
| Yes | 6 | |
| Sepsis | No | 0 |
| Yes | 4 | |
| Poor functional status (total assistance required for all daily activities) | No | 0 |
| Yes | 3 | |
| Disseminated cancer | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Age, years | <65 | 0 |
| 65-69 | 0.5 | |
| 70-79 | 1 | |
| ≥80 | 2 | |
| Cardiac comorbidity (dyspnea and CHF history, past MI or angina, peripheral artery disease, hypertension requiring medication) | No | 0 |
| Yes | 5 | |
| Pulmonary comorbidity (on ventilator, COPD history, current pneumonia) | No | 0 |
| Yes | 3 | |
| Renal comorbidity (dialysis, renal failure) | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Liver comorbidity (ascites, esophageal varices) | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Steroids for chronic condition | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Weight loss (>10% body weight in last 6 months) | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Bleeding disorder | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| DNR status | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Obesity | No | 0 |
| Yes | -1 | |

how_to_use.why:
- Uses easily obtainable information preoperatively.
- Derived to aid in preoperative counseling and discussions of informed consent.
how_to_use.when: Use in patients ≥18 years old undergoing general surgery (elective or emergent).
how_to_use.pearls:
- L’étude a examiné les données ACS NSQIP pour 7 interventions : pancréas ouvert, colorectal ouvert/cœlioscopique, hernie (ventrale, ombilicale ou inguinale) et chirurgies de la vésicule biliaire.
- Simila

next_steps.advice: Pourrait potentiellement être utilisé comme mesure de la qualité des systèmes.

medium_description: Predicts risque de perioperative mortalité dans general surgery patients.
